# API coverage

<!-- Generated by bin/generate from cPanel's OpenAPI spec. Do not edit; run composer generate. -->

Built from cPanel's OpenAPI documents: WHM API 1 spec 11.138.0.10, UAPI spec 11.138.0.10.

| API | Functions in the spec | Typed method | Coverage | Hand-written, typed results |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| WHM API 1 | 630 | 621 | 98.6% | 68 |
| UAPI (through WHM) | 693 | 680 | 98.1% | |

Every function, typed or not, can also be called by name: `Whm::call()` for WHM API 1 and `Whm::asUser($user)->uapi()` for UAPI.

## Functions without a typed method

These take a JSON body or a file upload, which WHM's form API cannot carry. Use `Whm::call()` with the parameters the documentation lists, where the function accepts them as form fields.

| Function | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `twofactorauth_set_tfa_config_for_user` | takes a JSON request body |
| `update_sql_config` | takes a JSON request body |
| `batch_create_cphulk_records` | takes a JSON request body |
| `personalization_get` | takes a JSON request body |
| `personalization_set` | takes a JSON request body |
| `restore_config_from_upload` | takes a file upload |
| `save_connected_application` | takes a JSON request body |
| `php_fpm_config_get` | takes a JSON request body |
| `php_fpm_config_set` | takes a JSON request body |
| `Backup::restore_databases` | takes a file upload |
| `Backup::restore_email_filters` | takes a file upload |
| `Backup::restore_email_forwarders` | takes a file upload |
| `Backup::restore_files` | takes a file upload |
| `ClamScanner::disinfect_files` | takes a JSON request body |
| `ContactInformation::set_notification_preferences` | takes a JSON request body |
| `Fileman::upload_files` | takes a file upload |
| `Personalization::get` | takes a JSON request body |
| `Personalization::set` | takes a JSON request body |
| `SSL::fetch_key_and_cabundle_for_certificate` | takes a file upload |

| `StatsManager::save_configuration` | takes a JSON request body |
